map.PDF页面旋转工具 使用指南: PDF Page Rotate Tool User Guide
map.纯前端旋转 PDF 页面方向，支持单页、批量、全部旋转，实时预览，文件不上传服务: Rotate PDF page orientation entirely in the front end, supporting single page, batch and rotate-all, with live preview and no file uploaded to a server.
map.扫描件方向不统一（横竖交错）时，逐页或批量旋转到正确方向，便于阅读打印。: When scanned pages have inconsistent orientation (mixed landscape and portrait), rotate them page by page or in batch to the correct direction for easier reading and printing.
map.批量处理一份全部倒装的文档时，用「全部旋转」模式一次性校正。: When a whole document is scanned upside down, use the "rotate all" mode to correct it in one pass.
map.个别页面方向异常时，用「单页旋转」单独微调，不影响其余页面。: When individual pages have the wrong orientation, use single-page rotation to fine-tune without affecting the rest.
map.：选中目标页面后点「左转 90°」或「右转 90°」，缩略图实时预览旋转效果并显: After selecting the target page, click "Rotate left 90 degrees" or "Rotate right 90 degrees"; the thumbnail previews the rotation in real time and shows the current angle. Three modes are supported: single page, batch and all, with one-click reset to the original direction. Rotation only changes the page direction, not the text or image content.
map.旋转会改动原文内容吗？: Does rotation change the original content?
map.不会。旋转仅改变页面方向（视觉角度），文字、图片等内容保持不变，可随时一键重置回: No. Rotation only changes the page orientation (visual angle), while text, images and other content stay the same, and you can reset to the original direction at any time.
map.提供单页、批量、全部三种模式，可逐页微调也可整体校正；大文件生成缩略图可能需数秒: Three modes are available: single page, batch and all; you can fine-tune page by page or correct the whole document; generating thumbnails for large files may take a few seconds, so please be patient.
